purpose: Define the acceptance contract for the future mecha_engine.provenance package module before moving provenance CI code out of labs/asset_pipeline.

external_references.title: SPDX License Expressions v2.2.2
external_references.used_for: Canonical Stage 0 uppercase SPDX operator and expression grammar.

external_references.title: SPDX License Expressions v3.0.1
external_references.used_for: Current SPDX grammar drift check; lowercase operator tolerance remains deferred.

external_references.title: SPDX License List
external_references.used_for: Current short identifier and exception-list reference.

required_public_surface.name: parse_spdx_expression
required_public_surface.contract: Parse the project-supported SPDX expression subset into license IDs, exception IDs, operators, copyleft/share-alike risk, and errors.

required_public_surface.name: validate_ledger
required_public_surface.contract: Validate required ledger fields, review status, SPDX expressions, inclusion paths, hashes, attribution, and decision-record policy.

required_public_surface.name: build_ci_report
required_public_surface.contract: Return the package-facing CI report for ledger validation, SPDX parsing, included hashes, and decision-record gates.

required_public_surface.name: generate_attribution_manifest
required_public_surface.contract: Return a manifest containing only assets that require attribution.

required_public_surface.name: hash_included_path
required_public_surface.contract: Return deterministic sha256 or sha256-tree hash metadata for an included file or directory.

ledger_acceptance: Require ledger_version 0.1.0 until a schema migration gate exists.
Require a supported SPDX short identifier or supported LicenseRef as spdx_id.
Require spdx_id to appear inside spdx_expression.
Require included assets to have existing included_path values.
Require included asset hashes to match committed file or directory contents.
Require included assets to be approved or needs_legal_review.
Require included external assets to be approved.
Require included share-alike or copyleft assets to provide decision_record.
Reject share-alike assets as default core assets without decision-record metadata.
Require attribution text when attribution_required is true.
Return JSON-serializable ok, errors, warnings, and summary.
spdx_acceptance: Accept AND, OR, WITH, +, and parentheses under the Stage 0 subset.
Return sorted license_ids, exception_ids, and operators.
Return contains_copyleft for known copyleft or share-alike identifiers.
Reject malformed parentheses and unexpected tokens.
Reject lowercase operators under the current project policy.
hash_acceptance: Hash directory files in deterministic relative-path order.
Include relative path names and child file digests in directory tree hashes.
Avoid network access and environment-dependent metadata.
ci_report_acceptance: Expose ledger_validation_ok, spdx_expressions_ok, included_hashes_ok, and decision_record_gate_ok.
attribution_acceptance: Include only assets where attribution_required is true.
Preserve asset_id, title, creator, license, SPDX ID, SPDX expression, source URL, attribution text, inclusion status, and included path.
Exclude internal assets that do not require attribution.
Return a stable manifest version until a schema migration gate exists.
negative_checks: package tests mutate sys.path to reach labs
package code writes Stage 0 artifacts as an import side effect
lowercase operators pass without an explicit schema revision
included share-alike or copyleft assets can ship without decision-record metadata
reference-only assets are treated as shipped assets
attribution-required assets are omitted from the attribution manifest
package metadata declares release license fields before the repository and package license decision is explicit
the gate is described as legal review or complete release compliance
future_verification_commands: python -c "from mecha_engine.provenance import parse_spdx_expression, validate_ledger, build_ci_report, generate_attribution_manifest, hash_included_path"
next_research_step: Use this gate as the provenance acceptance checklist when the user explicitly starts package scaffold or provenance package work.
